scope.description: Public RawNode safe-read output after locally applied committed removal leaves another node as sole voter. Continued invocation of the library API is in scope; no integration routing layer is assumed.
assumptions: Serialized calls and application of committed configuration through ApplyConfChange.
Distinct nonempty read context; static singleton configuration after removal; no lease-based reads.
StepDownOnRemoval=false is the target configuration; true is a permitted no-output control.
Caller continues using the removed RawNode rather than imposing an external shutdown policy.
excluded: Client-return linearizability, physical persistence or arbitrary crashes.
Progress guarantee for the true-option control.
A claim that every deployment continues serving removed nodes.
